sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Liberation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "When life goes to hell, you find out real quick who people really are. Who stays human, and who doesn't. Not everyone manages to hold on to their conscience. Word reached me that a new force has appeared in the region. All they care about is looting and taking whatever isn't nailed down. They call themselves the Raiders. Former soldiers and mercenaries, gathering into squads and putting key locations under their own \"protection\". Folks say they've got an influential patron somewhere beyond the border. Put those bandits down."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Shustrilo sealing foam
"So they're operating near laboratories and military facilities... Oh, I hope it won't start another war, on top of the one already going on. Well, kid, it's not for us to resolve this, at least for now."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Find and kill 6 Scav Raiders in The Lab or on Reserve.
